purpose: Record edge cases discovered by converting DOJ source rows into matter objects.

edge_cases.name: mixed_agency_mixed_status_row
examples: DOJ-SLS-LE-0005 Orange County District Attorney’s Office and Orange County Sheriff’s Department
edge_cases.risk: one source-row label can contain different statuses for different agencies
edge_cases.required_model_response: matter object may need child agency-status objects before public display

edge_cases.name: sheriff_department_not_city_police
examples: DOJ-SLS-LE-0003 Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department Stations in Antelope Valley
edge_cases.risk: elected sheriff accountability and county/parish jurisdiction differs from appointed municipal chief model
edge_cases.required_model_response: department schema must distinguish officeholder, jail/court functions, patrol functions, and elected accountability path

edge_cases.name: territorial_policing
edge_cases.required_model_response: jurisdiction schema must include territory/federal-local relationship and language/version handling

edge_cases.name: specialized_unit_or_subunit
examples: DOJ-SLS-LE-0012 Springfield Police Department Narcotics Bureau
edge_cases.risk: subunit matter should not be flattened into whole-department finding without scope review
edge_cases.required_model_response: matter object needs scope fields for department, bureau, precinct/station, or function

edge_cases.name: settlement_decree_lifecycle
examples: New Orleans sustainment, Newark partial termination, Seattle termination motion, Albuquerque termination
edge_cases.required_model_response: status event ledger must preserve motion/order/sustainment/partial termination steps separately
